source.prompt: Tropical house song, about 3.5 minutes, 108 BPM, B-flat major. Sunny, carefree late-afternoon beach mood, warm and bright. Smooth, airy female lead vocal with light stacked harmonies on the chorus. Steel drums melody, marimba, nylon-string guitar, soft Rhodes chords, warm round bass. Relaxed four-on-the-floor kick, offbeat open hats, shaker and bongos, soft claps on 2 and 4. Structure: instrumental intro (16 bars), verse, pre-chorus, chorus, short instrumental break, verse 2, chorus, stripped bridge with vocal and Rhodes, final chorus, instrumental outro that fades. Clean, wide mix with a tight mono low end.
source.lyrics:
[Intro]
Ooh, ooh

[Verse]
Sandals in my hand and the sun sinking low
Little paper boats where the warm rivers go
You call my name from the edge of the bay
And every worry just drifts away

[Pre-Chorus]
Turn it up, let the evening glow
Hold me close and we'll take it slow

[Chorus]
Coral sky, dancing with you
Every color melting into blue

Spin me round and round again
